findings.title: A trip with no return reads its absence window as done, so it leaves upcoming
findings.input: p1 in progress to 2027-05-15, home address, trip t1 left_on 2026-09-20 with no returned_on, today 2026-10-02
findings.what_happens: trip.absence_limit.t1 2026-09-20 to 2027-02-20 with no waits_on and trip.absence_limit.closes.t1 not in upcoming. With the fix3 done_when block taken out (mutant M12) the closing day is in upcoming waiting on t1.returned_on. Point 2 puts NONE in the fill domain of an ask field and point 30 says a U done_when keeps the window in upcoming with waits_on; the block reads the empty return as made.

findings.title: Two addresses both stated as the first are not a question, and the move is dropped
findings.input: lists stated, p1 in progress, ad1 since 2025-08-15 first_in_us yes, ad2 since 2026-09-25 first_in_us yes, no previous on either
findings.what_happens: No address.report window, no question, no conflict, no verdict reason naming an address. Two records cannot both be the first address; a move by 2026-09-25 has a report that would close 2026-10-05 under (f)(17), three days away. Same with ad2 stated first and also linked to ad1: window shown, nothing asked.

findings.title: A check-in asked early because a limit day waits on it is untested
findings.input: mutant M9 (drop `qid in self.checkins_waited or`); w1 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-30, confirmed 2026-09-10, today 2026-10-02
findings.what_happens: HEAD: limit day waits on checkin.w1 and checkin.w1 is asked. Under M9 the limit day waits on a question never asked (point 34), and every test in tests/unit/engine and tests/holdout passes.

findings.title: A kind with no record is read by the watch without being asked whole
findings.input: case with no passport or visa record and complete.passport and complete.visa removed
findings.what_happens: No watch row and no complete.passport or complete.visa question; with one passport entered complete.passport is asked. _use_kind runs only inside the loop over records, so an empty kind, the 'none found' of point 14, is never asked.

findings.title: A watch row on a record whose dates conflict is still dated
findings.input: visa vi1 issued 2026-01-01, expires 2025-01-01; passport pp1 issued 2030-01-01, expires 2026-01-01
findings.what_happens: span_order.vi1 is asked and the verdict is cannot_tell, but watch.vi1.expires_on shows 2025-01-01, -639 days, close, with no waits_on; windows of such a record wait on the conflict (point 32a), the watch row does not (point 33).

findings.title: Check-in words with record values reach no screen; the person is asked to type the confirmed day
findings.input: on_opt(job()) entered in the app; questions checkin.w1 and w1.confirmed_on
findings.what_happens: Home.tsx:142, 281 and Onboarding.tsx:487 call questionTitle without records, so the records option is used only by its test (overbuilt as it stands). Nothing in web/, api/ or desktop/ writes confirmed_on, so every app-entered job withholds its count and asks 'Last day the job and its hours were confirmed', a day the pack label says the app records.

findings.title: _out_of_order repeats the span read of ask_out_of_order
findings.what_happens: Both read the span fields with _own_day and test last < first; ask_out_of_order could call _out_of_order(record) and keep only the link test.

findings.title: Smaller points
findings.input: ad2 and ad3 both previous ad1; job confirmed 2026-06-10 before its 2026-07-01 start; check-in on an ended job; translated older case
findings.what_happens: Two moves from one address are not asked; a confirmation before a job began is not asked; 'Still with ...?' is asked on an ended job; a translated record stated whole today is read as confirmed today (parity, not marked as a reading).
